normative_extracts.quote: To signal abort on an AbortSignal signal with an optional reason: if signal is aborted, return; set signal's abort reason and run abort algorithms.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: AbortController mutates an associated AbortSignal once, invoking registered C++ and JS abort algorithms to cancel sockets, timers, and listeners.

production_failures.symptom: Stale search response overwrites newer query results in UI
production_failures.root_cause: Racing fetch() calls without aborting the previous AbortController allows slow earlier responses to resolve last.
production_failures.mitigation: Abort the previous controller before issuing the next request and ignore AbortError in catch.

production_failures.symptom: Memory leak from long-lived shared AbortSignal
production_failures.root_cause: Attaching thousands of temporary listeners to a single app-wide AbortSignal retains every callback until the signal aborts.
production_failures.mitigation: Scope AbortControllers per component or request lifecycle, or combine with AbortSignal.any().
